_note: Placeholders in double braces are filled by the service from the customer record and derived fields. callback_time is filled by the assistant from the conversation. Templates with used_by = service (BOOKING_CONFIRMED, SLOT_TAKEN, BOOKING_ERROR) are sent by the service only and are never shown to the model. SMS text stays in the GSM-7 alphabet on purpose (see rules, SMS CHANNEL).

templates.when: Sent by the campaign sender, once. Says who we are and what it is about, gives the opt-out, and asks permission to ask. No dates, fees or questions about the car yet.
templates.en: Hi po {{first_name}}! AI assistant of Toyota Manila Bay here, about your {{model_or_plate}}. May I ask a quick question? STOP to opt out.
templates.tl: Hello po, {{first_name}}! AI assistant po ng Toyota Manila Bay, tungkol sa {{model_or_plate}} ninyo. May itatanong lang po. STOP para mag-opt out.

templates.when: Owner replied to the greeting (hello, yes, sige) without answering anything yet. This is the first question.
templates.en: Thank you po! Has your registration been renewed this year? Just tell us, or reply 1=Yes 2=Not yet 3=Not sure.
templates.tl: Salamat po! Na-renew na po ba ang registration ninyo ngayong taon? Sabihin lang po, o reply 1=Oo 2=Hindi pa 3=Hindi sigurado.

templates.when: Owner says they are not the named person.
templates.en: Sorry po for the trouble. Do you know how we can reach {{first_name}}? If not, we will remove this number from our list.
templates.tl: Pasensya na po sa abala. May alam po ba kayong paraan para maabot si {{first_name}}? Kung wala, aalisin na po namin ang number na ito sa listahan.

templates.when: Owner answered 1 (renewed). Do not re-pitch registration.
templates.en: Thank you po! Would you like us to check the PMS or insurance of your {{model_or_plate}} instead?
templates.tl: Salamat po! Gusto po ba ninyong i-check namin ang PMS o insurance ng {{model_or_plate}} ninyo?

templates.when: Owner answered 2 (not yet) and window_status is upcoming.
templates.en: Thanks po. Your registration window is {{reg_window_start}} to {{reg_window_end}}. We can do registration, CTPL and PMS in one visit at {{branch_name}}. Would you like to book?
templates.tl: Salamat po. Ang registration window ninyo ay {{reg_window_start}} hanggang {{reg_window_end}}. Pwede po naming gawin ang registration, CTPL at PMS sa isang visit sa {{branch_name}}. Gusto po ba ninyong mag-book?

templates.when: Owner answered 2 (not yet) and window_status is open.
templates.en: Thanks po. Your registration window is open now until {{reg_window_end}}. We can do registration, CTPL and PMS in one visit at {{branch_name}}. Would you like to book?
templates.tl: Salamat po. Bukas na po ang registration window ninyo hanggang {{reg_window_end}}. Pwede po naming gawin ang registration, CTPL at PMS sa isang visit sa {{branch_name}}. Gusto po ba ninyong mag-book?

templates.when: Owner accepted. Only slots inside the registration window are ever offered.
templates.en: Slots at {{branch_name}}: {{slots_text}}. Reply {{slot_codes}}. Need other dates? Reply AGENT.
templates.tl: Mga slot po sa {{branch_name}}: {{slots_text}}. Reply {{slot_codes}}. Iba pong petsa? Reply AGENT.
templates.fallback_en: Our advisor will message you shortly with available dates. Reply AGENT to talk to a person now.
templates.fallback_tl: Magme-message po ang advisor namin para sa available na petsa. Reply AGENT kung gusto ninyong makausap ang tao ngayon.

templates.when: Before quoting the PMS.
templates.en: To quote the right PMS, what is your car's current odometer reading in km?
templates.tl: Para makapag-quote po ng tamang PMS, ilan po ang odometer reading ng sasakyan ninyo (km)?

templates.when: After the odometer. Estimate only.
templates.en: At {{pms_milestone_km}} km, your PMS is estimated at {{pms_price}}. The advisor will confirm the final amount.
templates.tl: Sa {{pms_milestone_km}} km po, ang PMS ay tinatayang {{pms_price}}. Kukumpirmahin po ng advisor ang final na halaga.
templates.fallback_en: I'll have the advisor confirm the exact PMS amount for your odometer reading.
templates.fallback_tl: Ipakukumpirma ko po sa advisor ang eksaktong halaga ng PMS para sa odometer ninyo.

templates.when: Owner asks what it costs.
templates.en: Registration service fee is {{reg_service_fee}} plus LTO charges at actual. I'll give the exact LTO total at the branch.
templates.tl: Ang registration service fee po ay {{reg_service_fee}} plus LTO charges at actual. Ibibigay ko po ang eksaktong LTO total sa branch.
templates.fallback_en: The advisor will confirm the registration service fee and the LTO charges. LTO charges are fixed by law.
templates.fallback_tl: Kukumpirmahin po ng advisor ang registration service fee at LTO charges. Fixed po by law ang LTO charges.

templates.when: Owner asks whether CTPL is needed.
templates.en: CTPL needs to be renewed together with the registration. It can't be dropped if the registration goes ahead.
templates.tl: Kailangan po i-renew ang CTPL kasabay ng registration. Hindi po ito pwedeng alisin kung tuloy ang registration.

templates.when: Optional third leg.
templates.en: Is your comprehensive insurance still active? If not, we can offer renewal, subject to the insurer's approval.
templates.tl: Active pa po ba ang comprehensive insurance ninyo? Kung hindi, pwede po naming i-offer ang renewal, subject sa approval ng insurer.

templates.when: Owner asks who does the emission test.
templates.en: Emission testing is done at an LTO-accredited center. Your advisor will tell you which one.
templates.tl: Ang emission testing po ay sa LTO-accredited center. Sasabihin po ng advisor kung saan.

templates.when: Ask before the documents list.
templates.en: Is the car under a bank loan?
templates.tl: Naka-loan po ba sa bangko ang sasakyan?

templates.when: Owner says the car is under a bank loan.
templates.en: Thanks po. I'll confirm with the LTO what is accepted for the CR, and let you know before your visit.
templates.tl: Salamat po. Kukumpirmahin ko po sa LTO kung ano ang tinatanggap para sa CR, at ipapaalam ko bago ang visit ninyo.

templates.when: After a slot is chosen.
templates.en: Please bring your OR/CR and a valid ID. If someone else will bring the car, we can send an authorization letter to e-sign.
templates.tl: Dalhin po ang OR/CR at valid ID. Kung ibang tao ang magdadala ng sasakyan, pwede po naming ipadala ang authorization letter na pwedeng i-e-sign.

templates.en: LTO charges are fixed by law po, so there's no discount on them. Ask the advisor about current service promos.
templates.tl: Fixed po by law ang LTO charges kaya walang discount dito. Itanong po sa advisor ang mga kasalukuyang service promo.

templates.en: Understood po. Card installment is available at the cashier. We can also book just the PMS and decide on the rest with the advisor. Shall I book it?
templates.tl: Naiintindihan ko po. May card installment po sa cashier. Pwede rin pong PMS lang muna ang i-book at pag-usapan sa advisor ang iba. Ibu-book ko na po ba?

templates.when: The SERVICE sends this after the booking is written. The model never writes it.
templates.en: Confirmed po! {{services_list}} on {{slot_selected}} at {{branch_name}} for {{plate}}. Ref {{booking_ref}}. Bring your OR/CR and a valid ID. To change it, reply AGENT.
templates.tl: Confirmed po! {{services_list}} sa {{slot_selected}} sa {{branch_name}} para sa {{plate}}. Ref {{booking_ref}}. Dalhin ang OR/CR at valid ID. Para magpalit, reply AGENT.

templates.scenario: Chosen slot no longer free (sent by the service)
templates.when: The SERVICE sends this when the slot is taken or no longer valid.
templates.en: Sorry po, that slot was just taken. Available now: {{slots_text}}. Reply {{slot_codes}}.
templates.tl: Pasensya na po, kakakuha lang ng slot na iyon. Available ngayon: {{slots_text}}. Reply {{slot_codes}}.
templates.fallback_en: Sorry po, that slot was just taken and no other slot is open right now. An advisor will message you with new dates.
templates.fallback_tl: Pasensya na po, kakakuha lang ng slot na iyon at wala nang ibang bukas ngayon. Magme-message po ang advisor namin para sa bagong petsa.

templates.scenario: Booking could not be saved (sent by the service)
templates.when: The SERVICE sends this if the booking store fails. Nothing is confirmed.
templates.en: Sorry po, we couldn't save your booking just now. An advisor will message you shortly to finish it.
templates.tl: Pasensya na po, hindi namin nai-save ang booking ninyo ngayon. Magme-message po ang advisor namin para tapusin ito.

templates.when: Owner says the window has passed or the registration has expired, and collection_available is true.
templates.en: Thanks for telling me po. I can't book you to drive in. We can arrange a pickup for your {{model_or_plate}}. {{collection_note}} Would you like us to arrange it?
templates.tl: Salamat po sa pagsabi. Hindi po ako makakapag-book na i-drive ang sasakyan. Pwede po kaming mag-arrange ng pickup para sa {{model_or_plate}}. {{collection_note}} Gusto po ba ninyong i-arrange namin?
templates.fallback_en: Thanks for telling me po. An unregistered car should not be driven, so I can't book a drive-in visit. An advisor will guide you on settling the registration first. Shall I have them contact you?
templates.fallback_tl: Salamat po sa pagsabi. Hindi po dapat i-drive ang sasakyang expired ang registration kaya hindi ako makakapag-book ng drive-in. Gagabayan po kayo ng advisor sa pag-asikaso muna ng registration. Ipa-contact ko po ba sila sa inyo?

templates.when: Owner says the window has passed or the registration has expired, and collection_available is not true.
templates.en: Thanks for telling me po. An unregistered car should not be driven, so I can't book a drive-in visit. An advisor will guide you on settling the registration first, then we can book your PMS and insurance. Shall I have them contact you?
templates.tl: Salamat po sa pagsabi. Hindi po dapat i-drive ang sasakyang expired ang registration kaya hindi ako makakapag-book ng drive-in. Gagabayan po kayo ng advisor sa pag-asikaso muna ng registration, saka po natin i-book ang PMS at insurance. Ipa-contact ko po ba sila sa inyo?

templates.scenario: Owner proposes to drive in while expired
templates.when: Never agree. Do not endorse.
templates.en: I understand po, but I can't book a visit that needs the car to be driven while its registration is expired. An advisor can guide you on the next step. Reply AGENT to talk to a person.
templates.tl: Naiintindihan ko po, pero hindi ako makakapag-book ng visit na kailangang i-drive ang sasakyan habang expired ang registration. Gagabayan po kayo ng advisor sa susunod na hakbang. Reply AGENT para makausap ang tao.

templates.en: Understood po, thank you for your time. If you change your mind, just text us here.
templates.tl: Naiintindihan ko po, salamat sa oras ninyo. Kung magbago po ang isip ninyo, mag-text lang po dito.

templates.en: Sure po. What day and time should I message you again?
templates.tl: Sige po. Anong araw at oras po ako ulit magme-message sa inyo?

templates.when: callback_time comes from the owner's reply.
templates.en: Noted po. I'll message you again on {{callback_time}}.
templates.tl: Noted po. Magme-message po ako ulit sa {{callback_time}}.

templates.when: Also used when the answer is not in the record or the templates.
templates.en: Of course po. I'm passing you to a TMBG advisor now with the details so far. They will message you here.
templates.tl: Sige po. Ipapasa ko na po kayo sa TMBG advisor kasama ang mga detalye natin. Magme-message po sila dito.

templates.when: STOP, TIGIL, or equivalent. Also sent by the service without calling the model.
templates.en: Noted po. You will no longer receive campaign messages from us.
templates.tl: Noted po. Hindi na po kayo makakatanggap ng campaign messages mula sa amin.

templates.en: Sorry po, I didn't catch that. Please reply with a code: 1=Yes 2=Not yet 3=Not sure, or AGENT to talk to a person.
templates.tl: Pasensya na po, hindi ko po naintindihan. Mag-reply po ng code: 1=Oo 2=Hindi pa 3=Hindi sigurado, o AGENT para makausap ang tao.
